findings.description: No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined for this bucket, so objects are stored without enforced encryption at rest, relying on defaults rather than explicit customer control.

findings.issue_category: missing access control / no public access block
findings.description: No ACL, bucket policy, or public access block is defined, and no versioning is enabled, leaving the bucket without explicit access restrictions and potentially exposed to unintended access.
This bucket holds ledger export data but has no server_side_encryption_configuration, meaning sensitive financial data is stored unencrypted at rest.
No versioning is enabled on a bucket storing ledger exports, which combined with force_destroy = true risks irreversible data loss or tampering without an audit trail of changes.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket storing model artifacts, leaving data unencrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration is defined for this bucket, so operational runbook data (which may contain sensitive operational details) is stored unencrypted.

The bucket uses the 'log-delivery-write' canned ACL which grants write and read-ACP permissions to the S3 log delivery group; while intended for log storage, combined with force_destroy=true it allows accidental or malicious removal of the audit trail, undermining the integrity guarantees expected of an audit log store.

force_destroy = true allows the bucket and all its contents to be deleted via Terraform without additional safeguards, risking accidental or malicious data loss on infrastructure that may hold business records.

findings.issue_category: destructive operation enabled on audit log store
findings.description: force_destroy = true on the audit trail bucket allows this security-critical logging bucket to be emptied and deleted, undermining the integrity and availability of audit records required for security monitoring and incident investigation.

findings.issue_category: plaintext file uploaded without encryption enforcement
findings.description: The object is uploaded into a bucket (reports_archive) that has no server-side encryption configuration, so this file (a vendor roster, potentially containing sensitive vendor/business data) will be stored unencrypted at rest.
